Can you recommend some science fiction books written by Terry Dowling?

gpt-4o-mini.title: Blue Tyson
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A gripping Australian science fiction novel by Terry Dowling, Blue Tyson delves into a futuristic world where technology and humanity intersect, exploring themes of identity and survival in a rapidly changing landscape.

gpt-4o-mini.title: Rynosseros
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A unique blend of science fiction and fantasy that delves into the complexities of alien worlds and their inhabitants.

gpt-4o-mini.title: The Clowns of God
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: An intriguing exploration of belief and existence through the lens of speculative fiction.

gemma2:9b.title: The Icarus Deception
gemma2:9b.explanation: A thought-provoking sci-fi novel exploring themes of consciousness and artificial intelligence.

gemma2:9b.title: Rynosseros
gemma2:9b.explanation: In this imaginative science fiction novel by Terry Dowling, readers are transported to a richly crafted Australian landscape where the boundaries of reality and myth blur, exploring themes of identity and transformation. The story weaves together elements of fantasy and cultural heritage, making it a unique addition to the genre.

gemma2:9b.title: Twilight Beach
gemma2:9b.explanation: Set against the backdrop of Australia, Terry Dowling's "Twilight Beach" is a captivating science fiction novel that delves into themes of identity and transformation in a richly imagined world. The story intertwines elements of the supernatural with the unique Australian landscape, creating a thought-provoking narrative.
